description: SEO-friendly e-commerce store + blog — Next.js storefront, Express + TypeScript + MongoDB API. Bangladesh market: SSLCommerz, bKash, Nagad, Cash on Delivery.
name: ecommerce-monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/web && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=apps/web & npm run dev --workspace=apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@ecommerce/shared
